abstract:
ABSTRACT This column highlights recently published articles that are of interest to the
readership of this publication. We encourage ABRF members to forward information
on articles they feel are important and useful to Clive Slaughter, AU-UGA
Medical Partnership, 1425 Prince Avenue, Athens, GA 30606; Telephone: (706)
713-2216; fax: (706) 713-2221; email: cslaught@uga.edu ; or to any
member of the editorial board. Article summaries reflect the reviewer’s
opinions and not necessarily those of the Association.
